entries.clue: What "throw" might do, in a tennis dictionary?
Bartended generously, at the tennis club?
Main trial venue for a tennis player?
It follows you, but not me
River to the gulf of Finland
Opening at the tennis pro shop?
End of an old Smith Barney slogan
Plucky tennis partners wear complementary outfits?
